sections.label: Global fossil fuel transition
sections.summary: Nearly 200 countries agreed on the need to transition away from fossil fuels in energy systems.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Nearly 200 countries agreed on the need to transition away from fossil fuels in energy systems.

sections.label: Singapore's 4 switches approach
sections.summary: Singapore's 4 switches approach covers solar energy, power imports, low-carbon alternatives and natural gas, with solar capacity at 1.35 GWp and a raised low-carbon electricity imports target.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Singapore is doing our part in this energy transition, as outlined in our "4 switches" approach, which comprises solar energy, power imports, low-carbon alternatives and natural gas.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: We have been accelerating green energy transition by scaling up the deployment of renewable energy projects and achieved an installed solar capacity of 1.35 giga-watt peak (GWp), a fivefold increase from 2019.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Two months ago, we raised our low-carbon electricity imports target from four GW to around six GW by 2035.

sections.label: 237 facilities energy consumption
sections.summary: There are presently 237 of such facilities, covering about 80% of Singapore's primary energy consumption.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Presently, there are 237 of such facilities, covering about 80% of Singapore's primary energy consumption.

sections.label: ECA energy savings results
sections.summary: Since ECA's 2012 introduction, the industry achieved average energy savings of about 2,800 terajoules per year, equivalent to about $230 million in cost savings yearly.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Since the introduction of ECA in 2012, the industry has achieved an average energy savings of about 2,800 terajoules per year, which is enough to power approximately 175,000 HDB 4-room flats, equivalent to about $230 million of cost savings per year.

sections.label: Second phase MEES chilled water
sections.summary: The second phase of MEES for chilled water systems applies to existing energy-intensive industrial facilities, which must conform by 1 December 2025.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: The requirement also helps new facilities avoid more expensive retrofitting and operational disruption, if they upgrade to more energy-efficient models down the road.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: We are now ready to implement the second phase of MEES for chilled water systems by applying the requirements to existing energy-intensive industrial facilities, accounting for about 80% of Singapore's primary energy consumption.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: These facilities will need to conform to MEES by 1 December 2025.

sections.label: MEES energy consumption reduction
sections.summary: MEES for chilled water systems is estimated to reduce industrial facility energy consumption by at least 245 GWh annually, and NEA will continue its consultative approach.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Overall, the MEES for chilled water systems is estimated to help reduce energy consumption in industrial facilities by at least 245 GWh annually, equivalent to taking more than 21,000 cars off the road.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: NEA will continue to adopt the consultative approach that was used to develop MEES for chilled water systems.

sections.label: URA Plan Lodgment EEOA requirement
sections.summary: Development works under the URA Plan Lodgment scheme will be required to meet Energy Efficiency Opportunities Assessment requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: One, development works under the Urban Redevelopment Authority (URA) Plan Lodgment scheme will be required to meet our Energy Efficiency Opportunities Assessment (EEOA) requirements.

sections.label: Bill expands EEOA and energy managers
sections.summary: The Bill expands the EEOA requirement to URA Plan Lodgment cases and lays groundwork for certified energy managers to endorse reports.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: To effect this, the requirement for development works to meet the EEOA in section 26A of the ECA will be expanded to include URA Plan Lodgment scheme cases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Two, this Bill will lay the groundwork to require certified energy managers to endorse the Energy Management System and EEOA reports to improve the overall quality of the reports.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng) (for the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment)
sentences.text: Using less energy to do more will go a long way to reduce business costs, power up Singapore's energy security and help us meet our climate ambitions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: It will extend minimum energy efficiency standards to more existing industrial systems and require more works under the URA Plan Lodgment scheme to undergo an energy efficiency opportunities assessment.

sections.label: Staggering report submission timelines
sections.summary: A registrable corporation with a water-cooled tube water system must submit a first report by 1 December 2025, and unregulated industrial facilities by 1 December 2029.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Presently, a registrable corporation with a water-cooled tube water system installed is required to submit a first report by 1 December 2025, to show that its operating tube water system performance meets the MEES threshold and that its measurement and verification system is accurate.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: According to NEA, existing industrial facilities that are not yet regulated under ECA will be required to conform to MEES and submit a first report by 1 December 2029.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Can the Senior Parliamentary Secretary share whether there are plans to stagger the timeline of report submissions by the various facilities over this five-year period?

sections.label: Penalties impact on smaller players
sections.summary: With penalties reaching $5,000, smaller players could be disproportionately affected compared to larger corporations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: With penalties for non-compliance reaching $5,000, we must consider whether smaller players could be disproportionately affected compared to larger corporations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: For a small enterprise already struggling with rent and low profit margins, a $5,000 fine for minor lapse in energy reporting could wipe out their profits for a month.

sections.label: Financial assistance for older systems
sections.summary: The passage asks what financial assistance or incentives will help businesses upgrade older systems and how Government balances retrofitting costs against energy savings.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Given that many local businesses may be using older systems, what specific financial assistance or incentives will be provided to help them upgrade and meet these new standards?

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: How will the Government balance the immediate financial burden of retrofitting against the long-term benefits of energy savings, particularly for SMEs?

sections.label: Simplifying reporting and aiding businesses
sections.summary: The passage proposes simplifying reporting, providing financial assistance, ensuring accessible training, and clarifying Director-General oversight rules.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: First, we should simplify the reporting processes so that small businesses can easily meet the new energy efficiency requirements without facing overwhelming challenges.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Second, the Government needs to consider providing financial assistance to help these businesses upgrade their older systems to meet new standards without breaking the bank.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: We must also ensure that training programmes for energy management are accessible to smaller firms.

sentences.speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng (Yio Chu Kang)
sentences.text: In addition, the rules around the Director-General's oversight needs to be clear and fair, allowing businesses to appeal decisions, when necessary.

sections.label: Energy programme since 2008
sections.summary: Since 2008, this programme has equipped over 1,500 energy professionals with technical skills to manage energy services in their organisations.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Since its introduction in 2008, this programme has equipped over 1,500 energy professionals with the technical skills and competencies to manage energy services within their organisation.

sections.label: Watson EP Industries energy savings
sections.summary: Watson EP Industries worked with EETC to assess machinery performance and energy use, saving about 63,000 kWh and $20,000 yearly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Another example is Watson EP Industries Pte Ltd, a small manufacturing company which worked with EETC to assess their machinery performance and energy consumption more accurately and to identify energy efficiency improvement opportunities, such as upgrading their inefficient air conditioning units.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: This helps Watson save about 63,000 kWh annually, which translates to about $20,000 cost savings per year.

sections.label: SMEs EEG Advanced Tier support
sections.summary: SMEs receive up to 70% support, capped at $350,000, under the EEG Advanced Tier.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: SMEs receive a higher tier of support of up to 70%, capped at $350,000 under the EEG Advanced Tier.

sections.label: SME annual savings from system
sections.summary: The SME will then enjoy savings of around $1 million every year from the more energy-efficient system.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Thereafter, the SME will stand to enjoy savings of around $1 million every year from this more energy-efficient system.

sections.label: MEES chilled water third phase
sections.summary: This falls under the third phase of MEES for chilled water systems, with compliance by 1 December 2029 for less energy intensive facilities.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: As mentioned in my opening speech, this would fall under the third phase of MEES for chilled water systems, where we have catered for a longer lead time for this group of less energy intensive facilities to prepare for compliance by 1 December 2029.

sections.label: EEOA reports via CORENET X
sections.summary: EEOA reports for new ventures are submitted through BCA's CORENET X platform, also used for building plan submissions.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: The submission of EEOA reports for new ventures is streamlined under the Building and Construction Authority's (BCA's) CORENET X platform, which is also used for the submission of their building plans.

sections.label: NEA flexibility for ECA companies
sections.summary: Under section 31B, NEA may grant time extensions or conditional waivers to companies unable to meet ECA requirements due to extenuating circumstances.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Under section 31B, NEA has the power to exercise flexibility to help companies that are unable to meet the ECA requirements due to extenuating circumstances.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Such companies may write in to NEA, which will then work with them to understand their challenges, assess the request on a case-by-case basis and, where appropriate, grant time extensions or conditional waivers.
